CG2 Ceramic Color Search Lab V3

Open index.html in a modern browser (offline).

New in V3:
- HEX mode includes interactive saturation/brightness board and vertical hue slider.
- HEX text, preview, and board are synchronized.
- Click any related color card to select it and recompute all 18 neighbors.
- Clarified common-name ranking bias: 0-80% is a heuristic weight, NOT a probability or measured frequency.

Other V2 input modes are retained. All processing runs locally.
